SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t JOIN activity a ON a.id = t.activity_id WHERE
AND t.assignee_member_id = #{assigneeMemberId}
AND t.status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS')
AND t.status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < #{now}
AND t.status <> 'CANCELLED'
AND t.status = 'COMPLETED'
AND 1 = 0

SELECT CONCAT('待审报名：', r.display_name) AS title, CONCAT('活动「', a.name, '」于 ', DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), ' 提交') AS detail, a.id AS activityId FROM registration r JOIN activity a ON a.id = r.activity_id WHERE AND r.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration r JOIN activity a ON a.id = r.activity_id WHERE AND r.status = 'PENDING'

SELECT CONCAT('待确认支出：', e.purpose) AS title, CONCAT('活动「', a.name, '」金额 ', FORMAT(e.amount, 2), ' 元') AS detail, a.id AS activityId FROM expense e JOIN activity a ON a.id = e.activity_id WHERE a.org_id = #{orgId} AND e.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY e.submitted_at ASC, e.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expense e JOIN activity a ON a.id = e.activity_id WHERE a.org_id = #{orgId} AND e.status = 'PENDING'

SELECT CONCAT('待归档：', a.name) AS title, CASE WHEN a.summary_confirmed_at IS NULL THEN '总结尚未确认' ELSE '总结已确认，可核对归档条件' END AS detail, a.id AS activityId FROM activity a WHERE a.org_id = #{orgId} AND a.status = 'REVIEWING' ORDER BY a.ended_at ASC, a.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration r JOIN activity a ON a.id = r.activity_id WHERE AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.capacity), 0) FROM activity a WHERE AND a.capacity IS NOT NULL AND a.status IN ('APPROVED', 'EXECUTING', 'REVIEWING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration r JOIN activity a ON a.id = r.activity_id WHERE AND r.status = 'APPROVED'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0.00) FROM expense e JOIN activity a ON a.id = e.activity_id WHERE AND e.status = #{status}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.budget), 0.00) FROM activity a WHERE AND a.status IN ('APPROVED', 'EXECUTING', 'REVIEWING')
